> a lot of the lessons of hypergrowth are relevant again as we see the productive chaos of the current AI-era, and this is absolutely one of them. In particular, it’s extremely clear that you can speedrun the early hypergrowth phase with a small, AI-empowered team, but it’s far from clear you can speedrun the late hypergrowth phase with the same approach
